title: Con Law II
description: Constitutional Law II: the First Amendment, Weeks 1–15 (Chapters 1–13). Covers the Religion Clauses, the speech framework, incitement and national security, true threats and speech integral to crime, immoral speech, torts involving speech, commercial speech, content-neutral rules and expressive conduct, government speech, funding and forum doctrine, government employees and public schools, and social media and elections.

documents.title: First Amendment Outline
documents.description: Case-by-case outline of Weeks 1–15 (Chapters 1–13), from Barnette and Kennedy v. Bremerton through Counterman, Ferber, New York Times v. Sullivan, Central Hudson, Texas v. Johnson, Shurtleff, Rosenberger, Tinker, NetChoice, and Citizens United. Each case has its rule, facts, holding, and dissent. Includes checklists for each doctrine, synthesis tables, and the stretch exercises. Every case box opens in the Look up panel on the practice pages.

documents.title: First Amendment Concepts Test
documents.description: 110 concept questions on the whole course, Weeks 1–15 (Chapters 1–13), in outline order: the Religion Clauses, the speech framework and unprotected categories, immoral speech, defamation and IIED, commercial speech, time, place, and manner rules and expressive conduct, government speech, funding and forum doctrine, employee and student speech, and social media and elections. It works like Shuffle mode: shuffled choices, cross-outs, an explanation for every choice, the rule, Retry missed, and a link to the outline section to review. Filter by chapter or shuffle the whole set.
